name: Binary inspector
provides: Look inside a binary file the person gave you: what kind of file it is, its headers, its strings, its symbols and its sections

install.system: sudo apt install file binutils | sudo pacman -S file binutils | brew install file binutils

asks: never: it only reads a file in the helper's own folder
note: It never runs the file it looks at, never writes and never reaches the network. It needs the sandbox, so it works on Linux only.
migrationDebt: Raw tool installation/execution and third-party SDK ownership must move to published BYOKit capabilities; this manifest records current behavior, not an approved bypass.
